instruction.text: This picture shows a paleontologist trying to find fossils. Select his hammer to learn more.

feedback.end: A paleontologist is somebody who studies fossils to understand how living things on Earth have changed over time.

atoms.text: This is Mary Anning, a famous paleontologist from the 1800s.

atoms.a: Mary Anning lived in Lyme Regis, a town on ...
atoms.sound: Mary Anning lived in Lyme Regis, a town on the south coast of England.

atoms.a: Lyme Regis is part of what we now call the Jurassic Coast, a stretch of cliffs and beaches ...
atoms.b: where lots of fossils have been found.
atoms.sound: Lyme Regis is part of what we now call the Jurassic Coast, a stretch of cliffs and beaches where lots of fossils have been found.

atoms.b: discovered many fossils of unknown extinct creatures.
atoms.sound: Throughout her life, Mary discovered many fossils of unknown extinct creatures.

atoms.b: One fossil that Mary discovered was a dolphin-like ((++animal ant)) called an ichthyosaur.
The ichthyosaur was a ((++marine sky)) reptile that lived between 201 and 194 million years ago. The ((++skeleton eyes)) that Mary found was 5.2 metres long.
atoms.sound: The ichthyosaur was a marine reptile that lived between two hundred and one and 194 million years ago. The skeleton that Mary found was 5.2 metres long.

instruction.text: Based on the fossil, what do you think an ichthyosaur would have looked like?

atoms.b: Mary was also the first person to discover a ((++fossil wing)) of a plesiosaur.
A plesiosaur was a marine ((++reptile insect)). It had a long neck, flat body and fins.

instruction.text: Based on the fossil, what do you think a plesiosaur would have looked like?

atoms.b: Another fossil that Mary discovered was a ((++flying sinking)) animal called a dimorphodon.
atoms.sound: Another fossil that Mary discovered was a flying animal called a dimorphudon

atoms.b: A dimorphodon had small ((++wings rings)), a short body and a large head.
atoms.sound: A dimorphudon had small wings, a short body and a large head.

instruction.text: Based on the fossil, what do you think a dimorphodon would have looked like?
